composition.serve_who: GMMS 108’-111 is the vessel’s +24 V DC distribution schedule. Its four titled distribution sections—AFT PANEL DC BREAKERS, FWD PANEL DC BREAKERS, EMERGENCY POWER SUPPLY, and EMERGENCY PANEL—serve the named equipment loads through individually drawn breakers; the left region additionally shows direct fused/switched service-supply feeders for the main bilge pump, fire pump, and tender winch. Panel buses, CT7/CT8/CT9/CT10 metering, emergency inter-panel feeders, and terminal strip T/S E belong to DC-distribution infrastructure rather than to the loads.
